question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

Wealthier countries are obligated to fulfil a __commitment__ made in the Paris Agreement to provide $100 billion a year in international climate finance
solution:
The correct answer is: **Breach**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Commitment **means making a promise or pledge to do something and following through on that promise. (**प्रतिबद्धता**) 

 
 
• **Example**: *John made a commitment to finish his project by the deadline, and he worked diligently to ensure its completion on time.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Breach **means breaking or violating a commitment or agreement, failing to fulfil a promise or obligation. (**उल्लंघन**)
 
 
• **Example**: *Sarah breached her contract by not delivering the agreed-upon goods within the specified timeframe.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Feeble **means lacking strength, weakness, or frailty. (**कमज़ोर**)
 
• **Drape **means to cover or adorn with cloth, usually in a loose and graceful way. (**टांगना**)
 
• **Hale:** - (of a person) strong and healthy. **(स्वस्थ) **
